query:
SELECT 
  id,
  status,
  contract_accepted,
  contract_accepted_at,
  contract_accepted_ip,
  contract_version,
  contract_pdf_url,
  renter_id,
  host_id,
  vehicle_id,
  created_at
FROM bookings
WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'in_progress', 'completed')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
